## A form (in the page)

- **`Please select how we can help you.`**: `dropdown`. In `ContactUsElements` as `PLEASE_SELECT_HOW_WE_CAN_SELECT`: `enter().pleaseSelectHowWeCan(option)`.
- **`First Name` / `firstName`**: `text field`. In `ContactUsElements` as `FIRST_NAME_INPUT`: `enter().firstName(...)`.
- **`Last Name` / `lastName`**: `text field`. In `ContactUsElements` as `LAST_NAME_INPUT`: `enter().lastName(...)`.
- **`Policy Number` / `policyNumber`**: `text field`. In `ContactUsElements` as `POLICY_NUMBER_INPUT`: `enter().policyNumber(...)`.
- **`Email Address` / `email`**: `email field`. In `ContactUsElements` as `EMAIL_ADDRESS_INPUT`: `enter().emailAddress(...)`.
- **`Phone Number`**: `tel field`. In `ContactUsElements` as `PHONE_NUMBER_INPUT`: `enter().phoneNumber(...)`.
- **`Message` / `Type your message...`**: `text area`. In `ContactUsElements` as `MESSAGE_INPUT`: `enter().message(...)`.
- **`SUBMIT REQUEST`**: `button`. In `ContactUsElements` as `SUBMIT_REQUEST_BUTTON`: `click().submitRequest()`.
